head: 4382891f0d5f0839669597cb5c90a98f24cfb8bd
kind: source-causal audit, no runtime measurement or edit
facts: Collector descends Located then Source and includes id.

ordered_blocks direct Located/Source roots recurse correctly, but the generic-container callback receives Located with Source body after Context root callback was suppressed. Its immediate ContextBlock match returns None, dropping that collected actual member.
Legacy duplicate-ID fallback uses the same recognition and can omit this member while by_id includes it.
Source(Located(ContextBlock)) retains immediate Located recognition and works.

Ref capture constructs Located(bareContextBlock); ordinary finish_occurrences receives Source-transparent mapper nodes and generally produces Source(Located(ContextBlock)). No actual frontend reverse-orientation producer is proven by this audit.

locate accepts arbitrary Content and public SourceContent/LocatedContent fields have no orientation restriction. The source-origin nucleus and exhaustive collector/session contracts do not authorize dropping the valid reverse-orientation input.
classification: Contract-level transparent Source handling is a bounded internal correction, but requires owning L0 clarification and meaningful unit RED before productive implementation. Do not broaden other carrier peeling or infer actual frontend parity from this shape alone.
proposed_tests: Generic MathFrac/Underline containing Located(Source(Context)) must produce exactly one ordered collected member with original Arc/chain and preserve Source span.
Duplicate-ID legacy origin including that reverse-oriented producer must retain first-ID order and last-map payload/chain, one unselected initial execution per ID.
Keep Source(Located(Context)), bare, directLocated and actual Ref capture controls unchanged.
refuters: An explicit ratified invariant forbidding Source inside Located would invalidate the claim of valid supported input; none was found.
An actual language fixture producing the reverse shape would upgrade frontend reachability from unproven to measured.
If actual unit execution does not lose the nested reverse member, recheck mapper callback suppression and withdraw the causal claim before fixing.
